current.title: Admin page and automatic bans for adult-labelled sites
current.summary: Owner ban list, admin page, and automatic bans for adult-labelled sites
current.details:
- banned_sites table: banned websites (and subdomains) are left out of
  search (/api/blocklist), their feed posts are hidden, and they can't
  be posted.
- admin.html + POST /api/admin, locked with an ADMIN_KEY secret: ban and
  unban websites, review takedowns, reports and hidden posts. Text only,
  no thumbnails or players. Wrong passwords are rate-limited.
- The page checker drops pages that label themselves adult-only (RTA
  label, rating meta, isFamilyFriendly=false, 18+ age tag, 2257
  statement), including pages that need cookies, and bans the website
  automatically.
- SearXNG uses strict safe search.

changes.subject: Owner ban list, admin page, and automatic bans for adult-labelled sites

versions.title: Pexels through the server with a private key
versions.summary: Search Pexels through the server with a private key
versions.details:
Pexels used to be searched from the browser with a key each visitor had
to paste in Settings. MeoDeo's server now searches it (/api/pexels) with
the site's own key, stored as an encrypted Cloudflare Secret
(PEXELS_API_KEY): the key is only sent to api.pexels.com and never
reaches browsers. Only MeoDeo's pages may use the route, each visitor
has an hourly limit, and results are cached for a day so the free Pexels
allowance lasts. Keys saved in browsers by older versions are deleted.

changes.subject: Search Pexels through the server with a private key

versions.title: Languages, rules and takedowns; Dailymotion fix
versions.summary: Fix Dailymotion embeds, add languages, add rules, reports and takedowns
versions.details:
Dailymotion: since 28 Sept 2026 embeds need a Player ID, and the old
player.html link answers 403 (black screen). Dailymotion videos now play
through geo.dailymotion.com/player/<ID>.html once a Player ID is set
(in gol/sites/dailymotion.js or Settings), and open on dailymotion.com
until then. Explicit and non-embeddable videos are skipped or linked.

Languages: a language menu translates MeoDeo with Google's free website
translator, loaded only after someone picks a language.

Takedown protection: Terms, Rules, Privacy and Copyright page with a
takedown form that removes a link at once from the feed and search
results; a Report button on feed posts (hidden after 3 reporters); a
content filter for adult, shock and piracy sites and words; and a
13+ / Terms agreement at sign-up.

changes.subject: Fix Dailymotion embeds, add languages, add rules, reports and takedowns

versions.title: Videos that match the search come first
versions.summary: Show videos that match the search first, unrelated results below
versions.details:
Searching "moon" used to mix music videos in with videos about the
Moon. Results are now split: videos whose title (or description) matches
the search come first, and off-topic ones (songs, lyric videos, games,
poems, or titles that miss the search words) go in a collapsed
"other results" section below. Sources now pass descriptions through
so the match can use them. The MeoDeo skill uses the same ranking.
notes: Sign-up: see v0.8.
Dailymotion videos don't play here: on 28 September 2026 Dailymotion started requiring a Player ID (fixed in v0.14).

versions.details:

  siteverify; a signed 7-day cookie; in-app browsers (TikTok, Instagram,
  Facebook, Snapchat...) skip. The signing secret is created once in D1.
  Verification turns on when HCAPTCHA_* or TURNSTILE_* keys exist.
- functions/api/verify.js; page checks, sign-ups and posts require it.
- UI: a verification screen offering hCaptcha or Turnstile (official
  widgets); searches wait for it; can't be dismissed with Esc.
- Tests use the services' published test keys.
notes: Verification stays switched off on the live site (no keys were added), so it doesn't appear.
Sign-up: see v0.8.

versions.title: Many more SearXNG results
versions.summary: Check SearXNG pages in separate requests for many more results
versions.details:
- /api/search?mode=candidates answers at once with known-site videos and
  the other pages as candidates (sites remembered as refusing are dropped
  or flagged), with one batched site-memory query; page=2 fetches more.
- /api/probe checks one page per request, so a search isn't limited by a
  single request's 50 outside calls; answers are kept 3 days in D1.
- The SearXNG source checks up to 48 pages, 6 at a time, shows results as
  they're confirmed (Gol sites can now emit partial results), and asks
  SearXNG for a second page when fewer than 15 play in MeoDeo.
- /api/site-report counts black-screen reports per site; sites reported
  more often than they worked get flagged.
- Node server supports the same flow.
notes: Sign-up: see v0.8.
Dailymotion videos don't play here: on 28 September 2026 Dailymotion started requiring a Player ID (fixed in v0.14).

versions.title: Remembers which sites allow embedding; "site only" flag
versions.summary: Remember which sites allow embedding; flag the ones that refuse
versions.details:
- server/site-policy.js: per-site record of what page checks found
  (allowed, inside, blocked, cookies). Sites that refused twice and never
  allowed anything are flagged and skipped by later checks, so the budget
  goes to other sites. Stored in D1 when the feed database exists, else
  Cloudflare's cache; in memory on the Node server.
- SearXNG also searches the news category; up to 30 page checks.
- Results that play in MeoDeo are listed first; cards from sites that
  refuse embedding get a "site only" flag; a setting hides them.
notes: Dailymotion videos don't play here: on 28 September 2026 Dailymotion started requiring a Player ID (fixed in v0.14).

versions.title: Better YouTube player, Odysee fix, YouTube's own search
versions.summary: Fix Odysee playback; give YouTube its own search backend
versions.details:
- Odysee: drop ?autoplay from embeds. With it, Odysee's player never

  Cloudflare Pages Function (functions/api/youtube.js) and by the Node

  otherwise YouTube's web search. The browser tries it before the
  public Piped servers, which were often down.

versions.title: SearXNG replaces Claude
versions.summary: Replace Claude with SearXNG via a zero-dependency Node server
versions.details:
- Remove the Claude finder and its settings.
- server/: Node 18+ server with no dependencies. Serves the app, asks a
  SearXNG instance's JSON API for videos, plays links Gol knows through
  their official players, and opens other pages to keep only ones that
  offer a video (embedded known players, og:video / twitter:player /
  JSON-LD players that allow framing, plain video files). Refuses private
  network addresses.
- Pages behind cookie walls, consent or sign-in are marked needsCookies;
  a setting (on by default) opens those videos on their own website.
- Gol: SearXNG and generic web sites, per-site checks for mixed results,
  sandboxed iframes for unknown players.
notes: Some sources may not answer anymore (public servers it used have changed).
Dailymotion videos don't play here: on 28 September 2026 Dailymotion started requiring a Player ID (fixed in v0.14).

changes.subject: Replace Claude with SearXNG via a zero-dependency Node server

versions.title: First MeoDeo: Gol and Claude
versions.summary: Build MeoDeo: multi-site video search powered by Gol and Claude
versions.details:
- Gol: a dependency-free library of video website definitions. It searches
  sites in parallel, recognises video links, and renders cards and players
  only through each site's official player (ads stay on).
- Searchable sites: YouTube, Dailymotion, PeerTube, Odysee, Internet
  Archive, Wikimedia Commons, NASA, Europeana, Pexels. Recognised and
  playable: Vimeo, Twitch, TikTok, TED, Streamable, Bilibili, Facebook,
  Instagram, Loom.
- Claude finder: Claude searches the whole web with its web search tool
  and reports videos through a strict show_videos tool; only URLs returned
  by search are kept. Runs in the browser with the visitor's own key.
- Static site with no build step, ready for GitHub Pages.
notes: The Claude finder is switched off in this copy: it needed a paid Anthropic API key.
Some sources may not answer anymore (public servers it used have changed).
Dailymotion videos don't play here: on 28 September 2026 Dailymotion started requiring a Player ID (fixed in v0.14).
